items.en: The English verb recommend carries praise into a suggestion.
items.cn: 英语动词 recommend 把称赞带入建议。

items.en: The noun ending -ation marks the act or the result of recommending.
items.cn: 名词词尾 -ation 标记推荐的行为或结果。

items.en: Modern English uses the noun for personal advice, for letters, and for official reports.
items.cn: 现代英语用这个名词指个人建议、推荐信，以及官方报告。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers long nouns with the same ending; the near-meaning group gathers words for advice and support.
note.cn: 形近组收结尾相同的长名词；近义组收表建议与支持的词。

entries.definition: Written material that proves or explains.
A place to stay or a adjustment.
An idea put forward for consideration.

normalIntro.en: The word is recommend plus ation: the act of praising becomes a suggestion, a letter, or a report.
normalIntro.cn: 这个词是 recommend 加 ation：称赞的行为变成建议、信件或报告。

normal.en: Recommend plus -ation: the thing that is recommended, or the act itself.
normal.cn: recommend 加 -ation：被推荐的东西，或推荐这一行为。

normal.en: A letter of recommendation is a praise that can be carried away.
normal.cn: letter of recommendation 是一份可以带走的称赞。

normal.en: On the recommendation of means because someone advised it.
normal.cn: on the recommendation of 意为根据某人的建议。

normal.en: Make a recommendation is the formal way to say give advice.
normal.cn: make a recommendation 是「提出建议」的正式说法。

normal.en: The plural adds s: recommendations, with no change in the stem.
normal.cn: 复数加 s：recommendations，词干不变。

abstract.en: A recommendation is a piece of another person's judgment you are allowed to borrow.
abstract.cn: 一条建议，是你被允许借用的他人判断。

abstract.en: Written praise outlives the voice that spoke it.
abstract.cn: 写下的称赞，比说出它的声音活得更久。

abstract.en: Every recommendation carries the risk of being wrong in public.
abstract.cn: 每一条建议，都承担着公开出错的风险。

examples.en: The committee made several recommendations.
examples.cn: 委员会提出了若干建议。

examples.en: She wrote a letter of recommendation for her student.
examples.cn: 她为学生写了一封推荐信。

examples.en: The report's recommendations were accepted by the board.
examples.cn: 报告的建议被董事会采纳了。

dict_mnemonic.text: recommend（推荐）加 ation（行为、结果）：推荐这一行为，以及推荐所形成的东西——建议、推荐信。

root: recommend（推荐）+ 后缀 -ation（行为或结果）→ recommendation；recommend 源自拉丁 recommendare；同族有 recommendable。

sensesIntro.en: The core is praise made usable; the senses move from advice, to a signed letter, to a formal report.
sensesIntro.cn: 核心是「可用的称赞」；义项从建议，到签名信，再到正式报告。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a signed letter placed in an envelope on a desk.
core.cn: 核心意象：办公桌上，一封签好名的信被装进信封。

branches.en: a short list of good options
branches.cn: 一张写着好选项的短清单

branches.en: a letter sealed in an envelope
a report read aloud at a meeting
advice spoken and advice written
branches.cn: 口头的建议与书面的建议

branches.en: a personal letter and an official report
branches.cn: 一封私人信件与一份官方报告

intro.en: The word adds a noun ending to the verb of praise, and the result names advice, a letter, and a report.
intro.cn: 这个词在表称赞的动词上加名词词尾，结果便指建议、信件与报告。

latinIntro.en: The Latin base is mandare, to hand over; com- and re- shape the verb, and -ation names its result.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁词根是 mandare（交出）；com- 与 re- 塑造动词，-ation 命名其结果。

definition_zh: 记录；最高纪录；唱片；录制；档案
definition_en: a written or stored account; the best result achieved; a disc of music; to set down or capture for later use
core_image: 厚厚的登记簿上，一行行墨迹整齐排列
scene: 田径场上计时牌停在新的世界最好成绩，看台上掌声四起。She broke the world record in the final race.
sceneCN: 这里 record 是「最高纪录」（第 2 个义项：已达成的最好成绩）；句意为她在决赛中打破了世界纪录。画面里可留意：停住的计时牌、看台上的掌声。

pos.zh: 记录；最高纪录；唱片；档案

senses.title: A stored account
senses.definition: a written or stored account of facts, events, or data
senses.definitionCN: 对事实、事件或数据的书面或电子留存
senses.example: The school keeps a record of every student.
senses.exampleCN: 学校保存着每名学生的记录。
senses.why: Recordari meant to bring something back to the heart, that is, to remember, and a record is memory made durable.
senses.whyCN: recordari 意为把某事重新放回心里，也就是记住，而记录就是被固定下来的记忆。

senses.title: The best result achieved
senses.definition: the best performance or result ever reached in a sport or activity
senses.definitionCN: 某项运动或活动中曾达到的最好成绩
senses.example: She broke the world record in the final race.
senses.exampleCN: 她在决赛中打破了世界纪录。
senses.why: A record once meant the line that holds the best result, and the word came to name the best result itself.
senses.whyCN: record 原指记载最好成绩的那一行，后来直接指最好成绩本身。

senses.title: A disc of music
senses.definition: a flat disc on which music or sound is stored
senses.definitionCN: 储存音乐或声音的扁平圆盘
senses.example: He still owns an old jazz record.
senses.exampleCN: 他还留着一张老爵士唱片。
senses.why: Music cut into a disc is a record in the physical sense, because the grooves store the sound.
senses.whyCN: 刻进圆盘的音乐是物理意义上的记录，因为沟槽储存着声音。

senses.title: To capture for later use
senses.definition: to store sound, images, or data so that they can be used later
senses.definitionCN: 把声音、图像或数据储存起来供以后使用
senses.example: They recorded the concert for the archive.
senses.exampleCN: 他们为档案馆录制了这场音乐会。
senses.why: To record is to set something down for later recall, and a machine now performs that setting down.
senses.whyCN: 录制就是把某物记下以备日后回想，如今由机器来完成这一「记下」。

senses.title: An official file
senses.definition: the body of written evidence kept by a court, an office, or an institution
senses.definitionCN: 由法院、机关或机构保存的书面证据集合
senses.example: The court record shows two earlier warnings.
senses.exampleCN: 法庭档案显示此前有两次警告。
senses.why: An official file is a record kept by an institution, and the word widened from a single note to a body of evidence.
senses.whyCN: 官方档案是机构保存的记录，这个词从单条笔记扩展为一整套证据。

intro.en: Record begins at the heart: to remember is to bring a thing back to the heart, and to record is to fix that memory outside the body.
intro.cn: record 始于「心」：记住就是把事物放回心里，而记录则是把这份记忆固定在身体之外。

items.en: Cor, cordis meant heart, the seat of memory in older thought.
items.cn: cor、cordis 意为心，在更早的观念里是记忆所在之处。

items.en: Recordari meant to remember, literally to bring back to the heart.
items.cn: recordari 意为记住，字面就是「重新带回心里」。

items.en: Old French recorder carried both remembering and setting down in writing.
items.cn: 古法语 recorder 同时带有「记住」与「写下」的意思。

items.en: Middle English record named a witness, a written note, and the act of noting.
items.cn: 中古英语 record 指证人、书面笔录，以及记录的行为。

items.en: Modern English added the disc, the machine recording, and the sports best.
items.cn: 现代英语又加入了唱片、机器录制与运动最高成绩。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers words with the same cord- core; the near-meaning group gathers words for stored information and discs.
note.cn: 形近组收同样带 cord- 核心的词；近义组收表储存信息与唱片的词。

entries.definition: To tell a story in detail.
A regular written record of events.
A flat round object that stores sound.

normalIntro.en: The word is about memory kept outside the mind: a note, a disc, a file, a best score.
normalIntro.cn: 这个词讲的是存放在头脑之外的记忆：笔记、唱片、档案、最好成绩。

normal.en: Re plus cord: bring it back to the heart, and you remember; write it down, and you record.
normal.cn: re 加 cord：带回心里是记住，写下来就是记录。

normal.en: The noun stress is on the first syllable, the verb stress on the second.
normal.cn: 名词重音在第一音节，动词重音在第二音节。

normal.en: Break a record means to do better than anyone before.
normal.cn: break a record 意为超过此前所有人。

normal.en: On record means officially written down and known.
normal.cn: on record 意为有正式记载。

normal.en: Record a song and keep a record use the same word in two directions.
normal.cn: record a song 与 keep a record 是同一个词的两种方向。

abstract.en: A record is a promise made to the future that this moment happened.
abstract.cn: 记录是对未来作出的承诺：这一刻确实发生过。

abstract.en: What a culture records is what it intends to remember.
abstract.cn: 一个文化记录什么，就是它打算记住什么。

abstract.en: Every record will fall; the keeping of it is what lasts longer.
abstract.cn: 每一项纪录都会被打败，而记录它的行为持续得更久。

examples.en: The school keeps a record of every student.
examples.cn: 学校保存着每名学生的记录。

examples.en: She broke the world record in the final race.
examples.cn: 她在决赛中打破了世界纪录。

examples.en: They recorded the concert for the archive.
examples.cn: 他们为档案馆录制了这场音乐会。

dict_mnemonic.text: re（回）加 cord（心）：把事重新放回心里，就是记住；写下来留存，就是记录。

root: 拉丁 cor / cord-（心）→ recordari（回想，把事放回心里）→ 古法语 recorder → 中古英语 record → 英语 record；同族有 recorder、recording。

sensesIntro.en: The core is memory fixed outside the mind; the senses move from a written account to a best result, a disc, an act of capture, and an official file.
sensesIntro.cn: 核心是「固定在头脑之外的记忆」；义项从书面记录，到最好成绩、唱片、录制行为，再到官方档案。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a thick ledger filled with even lines of ink.
core.cn: 核心意象：一本厚厚的登记簿，一行行墨迹排列整齐。

branches.en: a ledger open on a desk
a scoreboard frozen at a new best
branches.cn: 停在最好成绩的计分牌

branches.en: a disc spinning on a turntable
a microphone capturing a concert
a file drawer marked official

intro.en: The word joins the Latin word for heart to a prefix of return, and then spreads to discs, machines, and files.
intro.cn: 这个词把拉丁语的「心」与表回返的前缀结合，再扩展到唱片、机器与档案。

latinIntro.en: Its Latin base is cor, heart, and recordari, to remember; the prefix re- carries the sense of return.
latinIntro.cn: 其拉丁词根是 cor（心）与 recordari（记住）；前缀 re- 带有「回返」之义。

definition_en: a machine that stores sound or images; a person who keeps official notes; a simple wooden wind instrument
core_image: 桌上摆着一台录音机，红色指示灯亮着
scene: 桌上摆着一支木笛和一盘磁带。He pressed the button on the recorder and the interview began.
sceneCN: 这里 recorder 是「录音机」（第 1 个义项：储存声音的机器）；句意为他在录音机上按下按钮，访谈开始了。画面里可留意：亮着的红色指示灯、一旁的小木笛。

senses.title: A machine that stores sound
senses.definition: an apparatus that captures sound or images for later playback
senses.definitionCN: 捕捉声音或图像以供日后播放的装置
senses.example: He pressed the button on the recorder and the interview began.
senses.exampleCN: 他在录音机上按下按钮，访谈开始了。
senses.why: The suffix -er marks the doer, so the machine that records sound takes the same name as the person who keeps notes.
senses.whyCN: 后缀 -er 标记施动者，因此录音的机器与做记录的人共用一个名称。

senses.title: A person who keeps official notes
senses.definition: a person whose job is to write down what is said in a court or a meeting
senses.definitionCN: 专门把法庭或会议上的发言记下来的人
senses.example: The court recorder typed every word.
senses.exampleCN: 法庭记录员把每个字都打了下来。
senses.why: The oldest sense is a person who records, and the machine inherited that name when it took over the task.
senses.whyCN: 最古老的意思是做记录的人，机器接手这项工作后，也继承了这个名称。

senses.title: A simple wooden wind instrument
senses.definition: a small flute-like instrument played by blowing into a wooden tube
senses.definitionCN: 一种吹奏木管、形似小笛的乐器
senses.example: She played a wooden recorder in the school band.
senses.exampleCN: 她在学校乐队里吹一支木竖笛。
senses.why: The instrument took the name of the old verb to record, perhaps because its tone was thought to recall a singing voice.
senses.whyCN: 这件乐器借用了古老动词 record 之名，也许因为它的音色被认为能唤回歌唱的声音。

intro.en: Recorder is agent plus verb: the one who records, whether a clerk, a machine, or a small flute.
intro.cn: recorder 是施动者加动词：做记录的那一方，无论是职员、机器，还是一支小笛。

items.en: Recordari meant to remember or call back, the verb behind record.
items.cn: recordari 意为记住或唤回，是 record 背后的动词。

items.en: Old French recorder gave English both the verb and the agent noun.
items.cn: 古法语 recorder 为英语同时提供了动词与施动名词。

items.en: The native suffix -er marks the person or thing that performs the action.
items.cn: 本族后缀 -er 标记执行动作的人或物。

items.en: In the sixteenth century recorder also named a small wooden flute.
items.cn: 十六世纪，recorder 也指一种小型木笛。

items.en: In modern English the word most often means a sound or video machine.
items.cn: 现代英语中，这个词最常指录音或录像设备。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers words close in spelling; the near-meaning group gathers recorders, clerks, and flutes.
note.cn: 形近组收拼写相近的词；近义组收录音设备、记录者与笛类乐器。

entries.definition: A source of help in difficulty.
One who keeps a regular record.
One who writes down events in order.
A wind instrument with a tube.

normalIntro.en: The word is record plus er, and the same shape covers a clerk, a machine, and a small flute.
normalIntro.cn: 这个词是 record 加 er，同一外形涵盖一名职员、一台机器与一支小笛。

normal.en: Record plus -er: the one that records.
normal.cn: record 加 -er：做记录的那一方。

normal.en: A tape recorder keeps sound; a court recorder keeps words.
normal.cn: tape recorder 留住声音，court recorder 留住话语。

normal.en: A flight recorder is the black box on an aircraft.
normal.cn: flight recorder 就是飞机上的黑匣子。

normal.en: A soprano recorder is a small wooden flute, not a machine.
normal.cn: soprano recorder 是一支小木笛，不是机器。

normal.en: The plural is recorders, with the -er kept intact.
normal.cn: 复数是 recorders，-er 部分保持完整。

abstract.en: Every recorder is a witness that never gets tired.
abstract.cn: 每一台记录器，都是不知疲倦的见证者。

abstract.en: A recorder does not decide what matters; it simply keeps what passes.
abstract.cn: 记录器不判断什么重要，它只是把经过的东西留住。

abstract.en: The oldest recorder was a person; the newest is a chip.
abstract.cn: 最古老的记录者是一个人，最新的是芯片。

examples.en: He pressed the button on the recorder and the interview began.
examples.cn: 他在录音机上按下按钮，访谈开始了。

examples.en: The court recorder typed every word.
examples.cn: 法庭记录员把每个字都打了下来。

examples.en: She played a wooden recorder in the school band.
examples.cn: 她在学校乐队里吹一支木竖笛。

dict_mnemonic.text: record（记录）加 er（做某事的人或物）：记录声音的机器是录音机，记录事情的人是记录员，能吹出曲调的古老乐器是竖笛。

root: record（记录）+ 后缀 -er → recorder；record 源自拉丁 recordari（回想）；同族有 recording、recordable。

sensesIntro.en: The core is the one that records; the senses split into a machine, a person, and a wooden instrument.
sensesIntro.cn: 核心是「做记录的那一方」；义项分为机器、人，以及木质乐器。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a tape machine with a red light, a wooden flute beside it.
core.cn: 核心意象：一台亮着红灯的磁带机，旁边放着一支木笛。

branches.en: a red light on a tape machine
a clerk typing in court
a wooden flute in a school band
a machine and a person that record
branches.cn: 记录的机器与记录的人

branches.en: a clerk and a flute player both keeping time
branches.cn: 职员与吹笛者都在「记录」时间

intro.en: An agent suffix turns the verb record into a name for whoever or whatever does the recording.
intro.cn: 施动后缀把动词 record 变成做记录的人或物的名称。

latinIntro.en: The verb goes back to Latin recordari, to remember; the suffix -er is native English.
latinIntro.cn: 动词可追溯到拉丁 recordari（记住）；后缀 -er 是英语本族成分。

definition_zh: 康复；恢复；找回；追回；镇定下来
definition_en: to become healthy again; to return to a former condition; to get back something lost; to regain control of oneself
core_image: 病床上的人扶着床沿，第一次站起来
scene: 病床上的病人扶着床沿，慢慢把脚放到地上。He slowly recovered from the operation.
sceneCN: 这里 recovered 是「康复」（第 1 个义项：恢复健康）；句意为他在手术后慢慢康复。画面里可留意：扶住床沿的手、落到地上的脚。

senses.title: To become healthy again
senses.definition: to return to health after an illness or an operation
senses.definitionCN: 在生病或手术后恢复健康
senses.example: He slowly recovered from the operation.
senses.exampleCN: 他在手术后慢慢康复。
senses.why: The word pictures getting something back, and in illness what is got back is the body's former strength.
senses.whyCN: 这个词描绘「把东西取回」，而在疾病中取回的，是身体原有的力气。

senses.title: To return to a former condition
senses.definition: to return to an earlier good state after a fall or a shock
senses.definitionCN: 在下滑或冲击之后回到先前较好的状态
senses.example: The economy recovered quickly after the storm.
senses.exampleCN: 风暴过后经济迅速恢复。
senses.why: Health, markets, and nations all move away from a good state and then return, so one verb covers every return.
senses.whyCN: 身体、市场与国家都会离开良好状态再回来，因此同一个动词涵盖所有「回来」。

senses.title: To get back something lost
senses.definition: to find or obtain again something that was lost or taken away
senses.definitionCN: 重新找到或取得失去或被拿走的东西
senses.example: She recovered her lost keys from the sofa.
senses.exampleCN: 她从沙发里找回了丢失的钥匙。
senses.why: The oldest sense is to regain possession, and the body recovering health is a special case of getting something back.
senses.whyCN: 最古老的意思是重新获得，而身体恢复健康正是「取回某物」的一个特例。

senses.title: To regain money or losses
senses.definition: to win back money, costs, or losses that had been lost
senses.definitionCN: 把失去的钱、成本或损失重新赢回来
senses.example: The company recovered most of its losses.
senses.exampleCN: 这家公司追回了大部分损失。
senses.why: In business, what is recovered is value, and the word keeps its accounting sense of making the balance whole again.
senses.whyCN: 在商业中，追回的是价值，这个词保留了让账目重新平衡的会计含义。

senses.title: To regain control of oneself
senses.definition: to become calm and controlled again after strong emotion
senses.definitionCN: 在强烈情绪之后重新变得平静自持
senses.example: He recovered himself and continued speaking.
senses.exampleCN: 他镇定下来，继续发言。
senses.why: To recover oneself is to get one's own composure back, as if composure were a thing that had slipped away.
senses.whyCN: 「恢复自己」就是把镇定取回来，仿佛镇定是一件滑走的东西。

intro.en: Recover is a Latin verb of regaining that came through French, and its image of getting something back covers health, wealth, and composure.
intro.cn: recover 是经法语传来的拉丁语「重新获得」动词，其「取回」的形象覆盖健康、财富与镇定。

items.en: Recuperare meant to regain or recover, especially what had been lost.
items.cn: recuperare 意为重新获得或收回，尤指失去之物。

items.en: Recuperatio named the act of regaining, the noun behind recovery.
items.cn: recuperatio 指重新获得的行为，是 recovery 背后的名词。

items.en: Old French recovrer carried the verb into English with its broad sense intact.
items.cn: 古法语 recovrer 把这个动词带入英语，宽泛含义完好保留。

items.en: Middle English recoveren covered health, property, and composure.
items.cn: 中古英语 recoveren 已涵盖健康、财产与镇定。

items.en: Modern English extended the verb to markets, data, and personal calm.
items.cn: 现代英语把这个动词扩展到市场、数据与个人平静。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers verbs beginning with re-; the near-meaning group gathers verbs of healing and regaining.
note.cn: 形近组收以 re- 开头的动词；近义组收表治愈与重新获得的动词。

entries.definition: To tell a story in detail.

normalIntro.en: The word is getting back: health, things, money, and calm are all things that can be lost and regained.
normalIntro.cn: 这个词是「取回」：健康、物品、金钱与平静，都是可能失去又能重新得到的东西。

normal.en: Re plus cover: to get back what was taken away.
normal.cn: re 加 cover：把被拿走的东西重新取回。

normal.en: Recover from illness, recover losses, recover oneself: one verb, many returns.
normal.cn: recover from illness、recover losses、recover oneself：一个动词，多种「回来」。

normal.en: Recovered is the past form: recover, recovered, recovering.
normal.cn: 过去式是 recovered：recover、recovered、recovering。

normal.en: Fully recover means to return to complete health.
normal.cn: fully recover 意为完全恢复健康。

normal.en: Do not confuse recover with re-cover, which means cover again.
normal.cn: 不要把 recover 与 re-cover 混淆，后者意为重新覆盖。

abstract.en: Recovery is not the absence of loss but the refusal to stay lost.
abstract.cn: 恢复不是没有失去，而是拒绝停留在失去里。

abstract.en: What a person recovers from shows what that person can survive.
abstract.cn: 一个人从什么中恢复过来，显示出他能承受什么。

abstract.en: To recover oneself is the quietest and hardest recovery of all.
abstract.cn: 恢复镇定，是最安静也最艰难的一种恢复。

examples.en: He slowly recovered from the operation.
examples.cn: 他在手术后慢慢康复。

examples.en: She recovered her lost keys from the sofa.
examples.cn: 她从沙发里找回了丢失的钥匙。

examples.en: The company recovered most of its losses.
examples.cn: 这家公司追回了大部分损失。

dict_mnemonic.text: re（回）加 cover（取得）：把失去的东西重新取回，就是 recover——康复、找回、恢复都由「取回」而来。

root: 拉丁 recuperare（重新获得）→ 古法语 recovrer → 中古英语 recoveren → 英语 recover；同族有 recovery、recoverable。

sensesIntro.en: The core is getting back what was lost; the senses move from health to a former state, lost objects, money, and composure.
sensesIntro.cn: 核心是「把失去的取回」；义项从健康，到原有状态、失物、金钱，再到镇定。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a patient's hand on the bed rail, feet reaching the floor.
core.cn: 核心意象：病人的手扶住床沿，双脚落到地上。

branches.en: a first step from a sickbed
branches.cn: 从病床上迈出的第一步

branches.en: a market rising after a fall
keys found under a cushion
money returned to a ledger
a speaker finding his voice again
branches.cn: 重新找回声音的发言者

intro.en: A Latin verb of regaining passes through French, and its noun and adjective offspring name the process and the possibility.
intro.cn: 一个表「重新获得」的拉丁动词经法语传来，其名词与形容词后代分别命名过程与可能性。

latinIntro.en: The Latin base is recuperare, to regain, with the noun recuperatio behind recovery.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁词根是 recuperare（重新获得），其名词 recuperatio 是 recovery 的来源。

items.meaning: in the process of getting back

definition_zh: 康复；找回；经济复苏；恢复
definition_en: the return to health; the getting back of something lost; the return of an economy to growth; the restoring of data or a state
core_image: 清晨病房窗帘拉开，病人自己坐了起来
scene: 护士推开病房的窗帘，阳光照在床边的轮椅和拐杖上。Doctors expect a full recovery within two weeks.
sceneCN: 这里 recovery 是「康复」（第 1 个义项：恢复健康的过程）；句意为医生预计两周内可完全康复。画面里可留意：拉开的窗帘、床边的轮椅与拐杖。

senses.title: The return to health
senses.definition: the process of becoming healthy again after an illness or an injury
senses.definitionCN: 在生病或受伤之后恢复健康的过程
senses.example: Doctors expect a full recovery within two weeks.
senses.exampleCN: 医生预计两周内可完全康复。
senses.why: The noun names the process rather than the moment, so recovery is the road rather than the arrival.
senses.whyCN: 这个名词命名的是过程而非瞬间，因此 recovery 是那条路，而不是终点。

senses.title: The getting back of something lost
senses.definition: the act of getting back something that was lost or taken
senses.definitionCN: 把失去或被拿走的东西重新取回的行为
senses.example: The recovery of the stolen painting took months.
senses.exampleCN: 追回那幅被盗的画花了几个月。
senses.why: The oldest sense is the regaining of property, and health is described as property that has been won back.
senses.whyCN: 最古老的意思是重新获得财产，而健康正是被重新赢回的「财产」。

senses.title: The return of an economy to growth
senses.definition: the period in which trade, output, and confidence rise again
senses.definitionCN: 贸易、产出与信心重新上升的时期
senses.example: The city's recovery after the flood was slow.
senses.exampleCN: 洪水过后，这座城市复苏缓慢。
senses.why: A city or a market that climbs back from a low point repeats the pattern of a body getting well.
senses.whyCN: 城市或市场从低点回升，重复的正是身体痊愈的模式。

senses.title: The restoring of data or a state
senses.definition: the process of bringing stored data or a system back to a working state
senses.definitionCN: 让已储存的数据或系统回到可用状态的过程
senses.example: Data recovery saved the entire archive.
senses.exampleCN: 数据恢复保住了整个档案库。
senses.why: A disk that returns to its earlier state is recovering in the same sense as a body, so the word entered computing unchanged.
senses.whyCN: 磁盘回到先前状态，与身体恢复是同一种意义，因此这个词原封不动地进入了计算机领域。

intro.en: Recovery is the noun of recover: the act of getting back, viewed as a process with a beginning and an end.
intro.cn: recovery 是 recover 的名词：把「取回」视为一个有始有终的过程。

items.en: Recuperare meant to regain, especially what had been lost.
items.cn: recuperare 意为重新获得，尤指失去之物。

items.en: Recuperatio named the act of regaining, the direct model for the English noun.
items.cn: recuperatio 指重新获得的行为，是英语名词的直接范本。

items.en: Old French recovrer supplied the verb from which the English noun was formed.
items.cn: 古法语 recovrer 提供了动词，英语名词由此构成。

items.en: Middle English formed recoverie from the verb with the noun ending -ie.
items.cn: 中古英语用动词加名词词尾 -ie 构成 recoverie。

items.en: Modern English uses recovery for health, property, markets, and data.
items.cn: 现代英语用 recovery 指健康、财产、市场与数据。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers nouns ending in the same sound; the near-meaning group gathers words for healing and retrieval.
note.cn: 形近组收结尾音相同的名词；近义组收表痊愈与找回的词。

normalIntro.en: The word is recover plus y: the process of getting back, whether health, property, trade, or data.
normalIntro.cn: 这个词是 recover 加 y：把东西取回的过程，无论是健康、财产、贸易还是数据。

normal.en: Recover plus -y: the process of getting back.
normal.cn: recover 加 -y：取回的过程。

normal.en: The road to recovery is the phrase for a long healing.
normal.cn: road to recovery 是形容漫长康复的短语。

normal.en: An economic recovery is a market getting well again.
normal.cn: economic recovery 就是市场重新恢复健康。

normal.en: Data recovery brings a disk back to life.
normal.cn: data recovery 让磁盘重新活过来。

normal.en: The plural is recoveries, changing y to ies.
normal.cn: 复数是 recoveries，y 变 ies。

abstract.en: Recovery is proof that a low point was not the end.
abstract.cn: 恢复证明了低谷并不是终点。

abstract.en: A recovery is slow because it repeats in time what health does at once.
abstract.cn: 恢复之所以缓慢，是因为它把健康瞬间完成的事在时间里重演一遍。

abstract.en: What a person recovers from becomes part of the person who returns.
abstract.cn: 一个人从什么中恢复过来，会成为归来之人身上的一部分。

examples.en: Doctors expect a full recovery within two weeks.
examples.cn: 医生预计两周内可完全康复。

examples.en: The recovery of the stolen painting took months.
examples.cn: 追回那幅被盗的画花了几个月。

examples.en: Data recovery saved the entire archive.
examples.cn: 数据恢复保住了整个档案库。

dict_mnemonic.text: recover（恢复）加 y（名词词尾）：恢复这一过程，就是 recovery——康复、复苏、找回。

root: recover（恢复）+ 后缀 -y（名词词尾）→ recovery；recover 源自拉丁 recuperare；同族有 recoverable。

sensesIntro.en: The core is the process of getting back; the senses move from health to lost property, to trade, and to data.
sensesIntro.cn: 核心是「取回的过程」；义项从健康，到失物，到贸易，再到数据。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a hospital curtain drawn back, the patient sitting up in the morning light.
core.cn: 核心意象：病房窗帘拉开，病人在晨光里自己坐起。

branches.en: a patient sitting up at dawn
a stolen painting brought back
a market climbing after a slump
a damaged disk restored
a body and an economy both returning

intro.en: The noun is the verb of regaining plus a noun ending, and its family covers the process, the possibility, and the result.
intro.cn: 这个名词是「重新获得」动词加名词词尾，其词族涵盖过程、可能性与结果。

latinIntro.en: The Latin base is recuperare and its noun recuperatio; English added the native noun ending -y.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁词根是 recuperare 及其名词 recuperatio；英语加上了本族名词词尾 -y。

items.meaning: in the process of getting back
